title: Daily digest: Jail Gyanesh Kumar if SC strikes down SI | Rajasthan Congress chief credits organis | Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port  | Revanth pushes for 2027 OBC Census, part
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / The Hindu / BBC News
bullets_en: Jail Gyanesh Kumar if SC strikes down SIR: Prashant Bhushan in Hyderabad.
Rajasthan Congress chief credits organisational strength for panchayat polls victory.
Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say.
Revanth pushes for 2027 OBC Census, party adopts resolution.
bullets_ur: Supreme Court agar SIR ko radi karay toh Gyanesh Kumar ko jail bhejo: Prashant Bhushan ka Hyderabad mein bayan.
Rajasthan Congress chief ne panchayat intikhabat mein jeet ka sahra tanzeemi taaqat ko diya.
Libya ki bandar gah par Russian kashti mein dhamaka mashkook drone hamlay ki waja se hua, afsaraan ka bayan.
Revanth ne 2027 OBC Census ke liye zor diya, party ne qarardad manzoor kar li.
